Soy ingeniero de caminos y me dedico a <: I am a civil engineer, and my work is putting information in order with code and artificial intelligence. I come from the projects where you learn that the hard way: six years leading models, data and automation on major international works, where a misplaced piece of data costs millions.
Hoy trabajo desde Segovia, para España y: Today I work from Segovia, for Spain and remotely, on two fronts that feed each other. I build ONTOS, a personal and business digital twin kept up to date by an AI, and I do information engineering on commission: automation, data and BIM.
Los seis años anteriores a ONTOS los pas: I spent the six years before ONTOS on projects where the volume of information outgrows any one person, and the only way through is building systems that keep it in order on their own.
<b>Sydney Metro West (Australia)</b>Mode: Sydney Metro West (Australia)Modelling and automation on the Sydney metro works, with 41 cross passages delivered through code-generated models.
<b>HS2 (Reino Unido)</b>Modelos, datos y: HS2 (United Kingdom)Models, data and information coordination on the new British high-speed line.
<b>Northern Water (Adelaida, Australia)<: Northern Water (Adelaide, Australia)Water infrastructure of 140 ML per day, with data as the backbone of the project.
<b>NEOM (Arabia Saudí)</b>Automatización: NEOM (Saudi Arabia)Automation and information management on one of the largest infrastructure developments in the world.

Casi nadie tiene un problema de informac: Almost nobody has an information problem. They have an order problem. That is what I work on, from two fronts.
<b>ONTOS, el producto</b>Un gemelo digit: ONTOS, the productA digital twin of your life or your business: an ordered model of what you own, do and know, kept up to date by an AI and running on your machine. It works and you can see it. In private pilot.
<b>Consultoría</b>Me cuentas qué os come: ConsultingTell me what is eating your hours and I will build you the fix: bespoke automation and AI, data from the physical world with drone and photogrammetry, contract reading, websites. The most requested line is BIM requirements management in public procurement.
